sections.Intro: A remedy for acute catarrh, with increased secretions from the nose and eyes. It is indicated in cases of hay-fever and common cold. The characteristic symptom is a profuse, acrid nasal discharge and a profuse, bland lacrimation. There is a general feeling of heat and burning.
sections.Mind: Confused. Forgetful. Fears that the pain will become unbearable.
sections.Head: Headache, especially in the forehead. Vertigo.
sections.Eyes: Profuse, bland lacrimation. Eyes red and burning. Photophobia.
sections.Nose: Profuse, acrid nasal discharge, which excoriates the upper lip and nose. Sneezing. Sensation of a lump in the nose.
sections.Throat: Sensation of a splinter in the throat. Hoarseness. Hawking of mucus.
sections.Stomach: Appetite poor. Thirst. Burning in the stomach.
sections.Abdomen: Distended with gas. Rumbling. Sharp pains.
sections.Respiratory: Violent cough, with a sensation of tearing in the larynx. Hoarseness. Shortness of breath.
sections.Extremities: Aching and lameness in the limbs. Neuralgic pains in the fingers.
sections.Modalities: Worse in a warm room and in the evening. Better in the open air.
